REVIEW_INCOMPLETE — no blocking source or oracle findings.

Reviewed head: 99ff69b63e38a3e0627d859be898e74299f8bb69. Tested basis: fe098012eeb27d10a825f3c0f8fd9f3dfc6fdddf. Published-head readback at 2026-10-20 01:05:32 UTC confirms Draft, three changed files and current main a045441b71f23e146b7b9d32219e2b747036faaa. That combined tree is not executed here.

Inspected the complete source/test/spec/traceability change, adjacency construction, canonical graph identities, attribution, declared-target one-hop fallback, Rust Draft/Fast gating and package-selection consumer. A separate read-only source/oracle reviewer inspected the implementation and final documentation-only addendum; that reviewer did not independently rerun the author's tests.

The two-origin cap preserves membership: a discarded third origin is redundant for descendants already reachable from two distinct origins, at least one different from each descendant. Unknown seeds do not create connected nodes. The fallback stays separate, so missing targets retain only their existing one-hop effect. No capture/disclosure/cap/classification/schema/workflow change.

Observed proof: the original production traversal fails only the count regression at7e3995aec (native101;20pass/1intendedfail). Final head passes51focused tests, including4096 graph/seed combinations, literal cycles/overlapping seeds and three hard-cap controls. Shared-tail visits256/1024/4096 become46/94/190. Instrumentation counts actual neighbor iterations in production expansion, and declared fallback cannot mask the missing tail. Native check-fast passes14gates with the independent3-path selector and strict workspace/all-target Clippy; precommit, prepared goldens (0drift/0errors) and native dogfood scenarios pass. The first storage interruption and fixture-availability error remain recorded, together with their scoped recovery; no guard was lowered and no golden was blessed.

Raw receipts, reports, guard, source recovery files and executable custody records: https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/blob/4f3e69835cf3ac49f3f5b4e25a84f3a3973eb24d/manifest.json . Fresh bare remote readback verified all64files by size/SHA256. Executable/cache bytes are retained locally.

Missing: current-head hosted qualification, complete workspace test execution, non-Linux execution and combined-tree integration proof. Conversation review also records Gemini's quota-unavailable notice, which supplies no provider review; no quota request or bot contact was made. No inline threads/submitted reviews were present in the fetched inventory; that absence is not source-review evidence.

Keep Draft and all existing publication/integration holds. This COMMENT records inspection, not merge clearance; no Ready, merge-ready label, dispatch, merge, release, deployment, auth or protection change.
